mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression and carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate which potentiates oxycodone's respiratory depressant effects; carisoprodol may inhibit CYP2D6-mediated oxycodone metabolism to active metabolite oxymorphone.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with careful monitoring for respiratory depression, sedation, and overdose risk; counsel patient on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants.
